summary: BioCardia filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing that President and CEO Peter Altman will present at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference, held September 14-16, 2026, at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel in New York City. The presentation will cover CardiAMP autologous cell therapy regulatory progress, the CardiAMP HF II pivotal trial, Helix delivery and Heart3D imaging platforms, and business development activities. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. This is a routine investor-conference notice, not a special situation; monitor for subsequent material announcements.
